pathwayBasis.summary: Permitted issuers include State qualified issuers; over $10B outstanding, §4(d) requires transition to Federal oversight within 360 days or a waiver.

statusBasis.reference: OCC Cond. Approval No. 1356 (Circle, Dec 12, 2025); NYDFS trust charter (Jul 31, 2026)
statusBasis.summary: Per OCC CA 1356, Circle plans to move USDC issuance to its NY trust; its national trust bank will not issue. No §5 or state approval yet: anticipated.

reserveBasis.summary: Reserves must back outstanding coins at least 1:1 in enumerated assets incl. currency, deposits at IDIs, ≤93-day Treasuries, repos, government MMFs.

redemptionBasis.summary: Issuer must publicly disclose a redemption policy with clear procedures for timely redemption; fee changes require at least 7 days' prior notice.
